comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley disclosed the procedural status of class action complaints being dismissed via a motion to dismiss. Goldman Sachs noted that in November 2024, defendants moved to dismiss the consolidated complaint in the Agilon Health securities class action.
